messages.text: Map the chain from a Automotive market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Vector Network Analyzer.

| Chain | Automotive market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required VNA capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Automotive ADAS and V2X communications need high-speed signal transmission, and Automotive SerDes Alliance standards are used for in-vehicle high-speed data links [25][102]. | High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow uses insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance; R&S PCB test flow lists IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram for material/stackup selection [12][30]. | A VNA should support S-parameter / channel-style PCB measurements such as insertion loss and return loss with probing and de-embedding, because PCB test with probing is stated for impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, and the solution pattern includes VNA, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool [22][23][109]. |
| 3 | Low-DK glass fiber cloth is listed for high-frequency/high-speed PCB materials, including automotive use [105]. | Dk/Df is a measurable or extractable PCB material parameter: sources state raw materials such as substrates or laminates are measured for Dk/Df, and ENA/PNA-based flows include Delta-L loss, TDR impedance measurement, and Dk/Df extraction [17][21]. | A VNA used for this chain should cover the relevant high-frequency range and dynamic range; R&S ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5/43.5/50/67 GHz, and key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, and up to 170 dB maximum attainable range allowing full 2-port correction [34][42]. |
| 4 | Automotive SerDes / in-vehicle high-speed links imply high-speed digital validation rather than only RF testing, as SerDes-related automotive standards are described for in-vehicle high-speed data links [102]. | The measurable channel parameters named in the knowledge base are insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [12][30]. | For faster characterization or production-style monitoring, a VNA may require fast sweep / bandwidth capability; R&S ZNA has 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz base measurement bandwidth, 1 Hz to 30 MHz with ZNA-K17, and a speed example of 96 ms sweep time from 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz with 1601 points and 2-port calibration [34]. |
【推論】A supported sales/engineering chain is: automotive ADAS/V2X or in-vehicle SerDes high-speed data link requirement → PCB/channel SI parameters such as IL, impedance, DK/DF, crosstalk, and return loss → VNA capability for high-frequency S-parameter measurement, time-domain / TDR-related analysis, de-embedding, Delta-L PCB characterization, adequate dynamic range, and adequate sweep speed [25][30][34][37][102][109].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

- [[HSD PCB image 15]] 未提供 [[DK]] 或 [[Low DK]] 的數值門檻、測試頻率、測試方法、厚度範圍或標準版本。

- [[HSD PCB image 18]] 的「AI/5G 標配」是未標示日期圖卡的說法；不得推論 [[富喬]] 或 [[台玻]] 已量產、出貨或取得特定 AI / 5G 客戶認證。
- [[snla426]] 的 Df / εr / SDD21 表格是 TI application note 中的 high-speed PCB design reference；來源摘要未提供測試結構、trace geometry、stack-up、銅粗糙度、溫度、濕度或 measurement / simulation 條件。

Dk-Df › 來源中的說法
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在原材料表徵階段寫明「测量原材料（如基材或层压板）的 Dk/Df」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在材料選擇階段寫明「测量插入损耗、表面粗糙度和材料特性（Dk/Df）」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在電路板抽樣測試階段寫明「测量插入损耗、阻抗变化和材料特性（Dk/Df）」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在解決方案區塊寫明「基于 ENA/PNA 的 Delta-L 损耗、TDR 阻抗测量和 Dk/Df 提取」。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱[[玻纖布]]可依據[[介電係數]]（[[DK]]）和厚度做綜合等級區分。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱常聽到的 [[Low DK]] 是玻纖布材質低介電 / 低延遲的意思。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）將 [[Low DK 玻纖布]]列為次高階玻纖布，用途 / 特性欄為「高頻高速PCB板材、伺服器、車用、通訊」。
- [[HSD PCB image 18]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在材料演進階梯中把 [[Low Dk]] / [[Low Df]] 標為「低損耗」，並寫「降低訊號損耗，AI/5G 標配（[[富喬]]、[[台玻]] 主力衝刺區）。」
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Loss tangent（Df）或 Dissipation Factor 是 signal 沿 transmission line 傳播時 signal attenuation 的量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收；frequency 增加時，dielectric loss 也成比例增加。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 ultra-low loss materials 的 Df 通常範圍為 0.02 到 0.001；較小的 Df 會造成較低 signal attenuation；[[PCIe]] 等 high speed applications 需要低 Df。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 [[fiberglass weave]] 的 εr 約為 6，[[epoxy]] 的 εr 約為 3；fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 Df 差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 通常範圍為 2.5 到 4.5，並隨 frequency 變化；frequency 增加時 εr 下降。

PRS (NR) › 重點摘要
- [[NR DL PRS]]（DL Positioning Reference Signal）first introduced in [[3GPP Release 16]]。
- 來源明示 PRS described in [[3GPP TS 38.211]] Section 7.4.1.7。
- PRS reception procedure described in [[3GPP TS 38.214]] Section 5.1.6.5。
- 參數細節 described in [[3GPP TS 37.355]] Section 6.4.3。
- [[PRS resource set]] 與 [[PRS positioning frequency layer]] 相關參數包含 Point A、numerology、start PRB、resource bandwidth、comb size、periodicity、slot offset、resource repetition factor、time gap、muting option、number of symbols、RE offset 與 sequence ID。
- `DL-PRS-CombSizeN` 可為 2、4、6、12，表示 PRB 內每 N 個 RE 中 1 個 RE 會放 PRS。
- `DL-PRS-NumSymbols` 與 comb size 有 allowed combinations，例如 {2,2}、{4,2}、{6,2}、{12,2}、{4,4}、{12,4}、{6,6}、{12,6}、{12,12}。
- PRS grid 可由 `dl-PRS-ResourceSymbolOffset` 在 time domain shifting，並由 `dl-PRS-CombSizeN-AndReOffset` 在 frequency domain shifting。
- 來源範例配置：comb size 4、RE offset 2、resource symbol offset 2、numSymbols 4。
- 來源 current understanding 說 PRS 不允許 overlap with SSB OFDM symbols；若 PRS 與 PDCCH / PDSCH collision，PRS higher priority，PDCCH / PDSCH 會被 punctured。
- 來源 customer test case requirements 又說 RA-RNTI / SI-RNTI PDSCH higher priority than PRS、C-RNTI PDSCH lower priority than PRS、PDCCH higher priority than PRS、LTE-CRS higher priority than PRS、CSI-RS higher priority than PRS、PRS higher priority than OCNG。這與 current understanding 的 PDCCH priority 敘述有內部矛盾。
- 目前 customer test case requirements 說 PRS requested only for [[NR FR1]]；eventually needed for [[NR FR2]] but much later，且有可能出現 FR2 BW 200 MHz with PRS enabled 的 test cases。
- Multi-numerology test cases with PRS are not foreseen；來源預期同一 TRP 不會配置兩個不同 numerology 的 PRS resource sets，且 PRS numerology always aligned with active [[BWP]] numerology。

- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。

| 3 | Low-DK glass fiber cloth is listed for high-frequency/high-speed PCB materials, including automotive use [105]. | Dk/Df is a measurable or extractable PCB material parameter: sources state raw materials such as substrates or laminates are measured for Dk/Df, and ENA/PNA-based flows include Delta-L loss, TDR impedance measurement, and Dk/Df extraction [17][21]. | A VNA used for this chain should cover the relevant high-frequency range and dynamic range; R&S ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5/43.5/50/67 GHz, and key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, and up to 170 dB maximum attainable range allowing full 2-port correction [34][42]. |
